mirror_host.description: Hostname of the upstream Debian mirror (e.g. ftp.de.debian.org, a local CDN entry point, or a Debian mirror list host)

remote_path.description: Absolute path on the remote mirror host that forms the root of the Debian archive (almost always /debian)

local_path.description: Absolute path to the local directory that will hold the mirrored files; must have sufficient free space

arch.description: CPU architectures to mirror; use 'all' to include architecture-independent packages

items.description: Architecture name as used by Debian, e.g. amd64, i386, arm64, armhf

dist.description: Distribution suites to mirror; combine stable codenames with their -updates and -security companions

items.description: Suite name such as bookworm, stable, bullseye-updates, or buster-security

section.description: Repository sections to include; non-free-firmware is required for most modern hardware drivers

items.description: Section name: main, contrib, non-free, or non-free-firmware

proto.description: Transfer protocol: http (recommended for public mirrors), ftp, hftp, or rsync (fastest for sustained sync)

passive.description: Enable passive FTP mode; leave on unless the mirror server explicitly requires active mode

nosource.description: Omit source packages from the mirror; saves roughly 30-40% disk space but makes the mirror non-buildable

cleanup.description: Remove local files that have been removed from the upstream mirror after each successful run

i18n.description: Mirror Translation files so apt can display package descriptions in non-English locales

ignore_missing_info.description: Suppress fatal errors when package-info entries are absent; useful for partial or unofficial mirrors

diff_mode.description: Diff handling strategy: use = download and apply upstream diffs (least bandwidth), mirror = store diffs, generate = create diffs locally, none = always download full index files

timeout.description: Seconds before a stalled network connection is abandoned; increase on slow or high-latency uplinks

retries.description: How many times debmirror will retry a failed file download before marking the run as failed

max_batch.description: Maximum number of package files downloaded in a single run; 0 means unlimited (mirror everything outstanding)

keyring.description: Path to the GPG keyring file used to verify the cryptographic signature on Release files

log_file.description: Absolute path to the log file; set to an empty string to send log output to stdout (suitable for systemd units)

rsync_bwlimit.description: Bandwidth cap in KB/s passed to rsync via --bwlimit; 0 disables the cap; ignored when proto is not rsync

exclude.description: Perl-compatible regex patterns matched against file paths relative to the mirror root; matching files are not downloaded

items.description: Perl regex pattern, e.g. ~$ to skip editor backup files or \.bz2$ to skip bzip2-compressed index variants

postscript.description: Shell command or absolute script path executed once after each successful mirror run; leave empty to disable (useful for triggering apt-ftparchive or sending alerts)
